style.styleTitle: Personalised Watercolour Robin Ceramic LED House Christmas Ornament by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: Bring a warm festive glow to your home with this Personalised Watercolour Robin Ceramic LED House Ornament. Featuring a beautifully illustrated watercolour robin design and soft LED lighting, this charming ceramic decoration can be personalised with 3 lines of up to 20 characters each, making it a thoughtful Christmas gift or treasured keepsake. Measuring 13cm wide, 10cm tall and 7.5cm deep, the house is perfectly sized for a mantelpiece, shelf or windowsill. It features a simple on/off switch at the base for easy use. Requires 3 x LR44 batteries (Batteries included). This item is hand finished and may be subject to some imperfections. Perfect for shelves, mantelpieces or windowsills, this personalised ornament adds a cosy, magical and contemporary touch to any festive home décor.
